headers.H1 current: logo, title, status, account, help, settings, watch link, invite, go live
headers.H2 share + menu: logo + title, Share (guests and viewers in one), Go live, account menu (help, settings, sign in)
headers.H3 share + menu, live in dock: as H2, with Go live moved to the bottom bar next to Record

panels.P1 current: icon rail (Chat, Show, Look, AI); Show is one long page of ~25 controls with folds
panels.P2 rail + Show subtabs: same rail; Show split into Inbox / Engage / Page subtabs
panels.P3 top tabs, no rail: tabs across the top of the panel (Chat, Show, Look, AI) instead of a rail; Show subtabs as P2
panels.P4 top tabs, inbox in chat: as P3, but voice questions and super chats wait in a strip at the top of Chat (where hosts already are); Show = Engage + Page
